Crafted for high-fidelity audio playback, curated YouTube video streaming, authentic real-time FFT spectrum visualization, and deep musical exploration via SN-Lexicon.\n\nDesigned for Smartphones, Tablets & Android TV.
👑 HER MAJESTY'S ROYAL USER MANUAL & FAQ
By Royal Appointment to Her Majesty's Station North Realm
Q: How does one command Her Majesty's Television & Radio Streams?

A: One simply toggles between SN-TV (for majestic video broadcasts) and SN-RADIO (for glorious audio streams with spectrum visualizer). Should one desire true regal immersion, tapping the screen reveals Her Majesty's Heads-Up Display (HUD) or enters True Fullscreen.
Q: How does one administer playlists in the Royal Curator Studio?

A: We command that all playlist administration take place exclusively inside the Settings Hub. Tapping Saved Playlists allows one to select the Station North Main Mix (100 Hits), US R&B Top 50, or US HipHop Top 50, as well as create, rename, or delete custom royal playlists.
Q: May one import YouTube Playlists by Royal Decree?
A: Indeed! Paste any YouTube playlist link or ID into the input bar and press Load. One may then append or replace tracks at Her Majesty's pleasure.
Q: How does one explore the Royal SN-Lexicon (4,400+ Entities)?

A: Open the Lexicon tab to explore over 4,438 artists across US Hip-Hop, R&B, and Urban Culture. Each artist features complete biographies, discographies, and direct YouTube search links. Look out for Her Majesty's Genre Badges: 🎤 US HIP-HOP, 🎵 R&B / URBAN, and 🔥 R&B & HIP-HOP.
Q: How does one inspect or export System Diagnostics & Terminal Logs?
A: One may tap 💻 Toggle Logs to inspect real-time operations, 📋 Copy Logs to store them in the clipboard, or 💾 Save .txt to export a permanent diagnostic file via the Storage Access Framework.
